summary: Phase 60 backend regression after video_calls refactor (server.py -> routers/video_calls.py). 16/17 tests PASS, 1 SKIPPED (video upload — Cloudinary rejects synthetic mp4 in env, not a code bug). The refactored /api/calls/* endpoints work correctly: Jitsi Meet URLs returned, prejoinPageEnabled=false present, startWithVideoMuted toggles correctly for audio vs video, status transitions ringing -> active/declined/ended verified end-to-end. Recommended-videos algorithmic feed works for both auth + anon. Location share -> chat message visibility (iter_59 fix) confirmed live. Cards, stories, AI chat all pass.

minor.issue: Could not be functionally validated in this run — Cloudinary rejected the synthetic mp4 payload used by the test (would need a real H.264-encoded mp4 sample, and ffmpeg is not installed in the test environment). Test is marked SKIPPED with a clear message. Code review of /app/backend/routers/uploads.py shows the video branch correctly detects video by content-type OR extension, calls cloudinary.uploader.upload[_large] with resource_type='video', eager_async=True, and synthesizes mp4_url / poster_url / f_auto_url from /upload/ URL transforms when eager derivatives aren't ready — contract looks correct.
Module imports routers/push_notifications inside the try block on every call (lines 87-107) — minor perf nit only. Failures are already swallowed with warnings, so non-blocking.

action_items: (Optional) If main agent wants 100% backend coverage for the video upload path, install ffmpeg (or include a tiny pre-baked H.264 mp4 fixture under /app/backend/tests/fixtures/tiny.mp4) so test_video_upload_returns_mp4_and_poster_fields can actually hit Cloudinary.
(Nit) routers/video_calls.py imports push_notifications lazily inside the request handler — could be hoisted to module top to save 1 import-cost per call, with try/except guarding the call itself.
critical_code_review_comments: routers/video_calls.py: start_video_call passes chat['participants'] (which includes the caller) into the call_doc — that's fine because answer/end checks `participants: current_user.id`. ✅
routers/video_calls.py: answer/decline correctly filter by status='ringing' so a re-answer attempt 404s — good.
routers/video_calls.py: end_call does NOT filter on status, so a caller can re-end an already-ended call without error. Minor — idempotent but no-op. Acceptable.

routers/uploads.py video branch: synthesizes mp4_url by `base_url.replace('/upload/', '/upload/f_mp4,vc_h264.../')` then `.rsplit('.', 1)[0] + '.mp4'`. If Cloudinary ever returns a URL with multiple dots in the public_id (e.g. `my.video.mov`), the rsplit only strips the last extension — correct. ✅
routers/posts_feed.py get_recommended_videos: pool capped at 400, scoring is O(n) — performance OK. Anonymous path skips personal signals correctly. ✅
server.py still has 3033 lines — recommend continuing the extraction trend (cards, stories, ai/chat are next obvious candidates).
